description: We are a students for Instituto Cervino
summary:
Our project is about creating an interactive quiz game to teach people about the Moon's South Pole. The game includes multiple-choice questions that help players learn about the Moon, its landing sites, and space exploration. It addresses the challenge by making learning about the Moon simple, fun, and interactive. The Moon's South Pole is important because it may contain frozen water, offers opportunities for scientific discoveries, and could help astronauts prepare for future missions and explore space.
What were your first ideas? 
My first idea was to create a simple game where players learn about the Moon and its landing sites.

Which did you chose? 
I chose to create an interactive quiz game with multiple-choice question

Why would it work?
Because it is easy to understand, fun to play, and helps people learn about the Moon.

What steps have you taken?

I researched the Moon's south pole.
I chose the main topic of my game.
I planned the questions and answers.
I started designing the game in Genially.
details:
Our project is an interactive quiz game about the Moon's South Pole. Players answer multiple-choice questions to learn interesting facts about the Moon and space exploration.

The game helps people learn in a fun and easy way. Its main benefit is making science more interesting and helping players understand why the Moon's South Pole is important for future missions.

We used Genially to design and create our game. Our team considered the questions, answers, difficulty level, and design to make the game easy to understand and enjoyable.

Our project is creative because it uses a game to teach people about space. We want players to have fun while learning and become more interested in exploring the Moon.
